extName.description: The extension name. A proper name: do not translate.

extDescription.message: Let an AI agent ride along in this browser — see your tabs, read and edit pages you allow, site by site.

commandTogglePause.message: Pause or resume beifahrer (the agent gets nothing while paused)

status_offline.message: No agent session on ports $RANGE$ — each starts with your agent. Looking every few seconds.

status_unauthorized.message: An agent session refused the pairing token. Paste the current one in the settings.

status_protocol.message: An agent session and the extension do not match. Update the older one.

status_protocol_detail.message: An agent session and the extension do not match: $DETAIL$. Update the older one.

status_unpaired.message: Not paired yet — open the settings and paste the token from `beifahrer token`.

banner_unpaired.message: Not paired with an agent yet

banner_unauthorized.message: An agent session refused the pairing token

banner_protocol.message: An agent session and the extension do not match

agent_disconnect_tooltip.message: Close this session’s connection. It stays closed until the agent session restarts.

pause_title.message: Let the agent use this browser

pause_running.message: The agent may use this browser within the limits below.

pause_paused.message: Paused. The agent gets nothing from this browser, not even the list of tabs.

site_none.message: not a web page — nothing to allow here

level_group_label.message: What the agent may do on this site

hint_none.message: The agent sees only that a tab on this site is open.

hint_read.message: The agent may read this page and its outline (and take a screenshot, if you allow those). It cannot change anything.

hint_write.message: The agent may also fill fields and click here.

hint_denied.message: The browser did not grant access, so the level stays as it was.

features_description.message: One switch per capability, for the whole browser. The level you set for each site still applies on top.

activity_empty.message: Nothing yet. What the agent does here is listed until the browser closes.

feature_tabs_detail.message: tabs_list, tab_active — sites below Read show their host only

feature_outline_detail.message: page_outline, page_find, page_wait — links, buttons, fields

feature_screenshot_detail.message: page_screenshot — of the visible tab only; Chromium also needs the all-sites grant below

feature_fill_detail.message: page_fill — still needs Read + edit on the site

feature_click_detail.message: page_click — still needs Read + edit on the site

feature_open_detail.message: tab_open — only sites at Read or higher

feature_manageTabs_detail.message: tabs_move, tabs_pin, tabs_close, tabs_group, tabs_ungroup, window_create

toolbar_paused.message: beifahrer is paused — the agent gets nothing from this browser. Click to resume.

toolbar_active.message: beifahrer — an agent is using this browser right now. Click to see what, or to stop it.

toolbar_idle.message: beifahrer — connected to an agent, idle. Click to see the activity or pause.

toolbar_offline_unpaired.message: beifahrer — not paired yet. No agent can reach this browser.

toolbar_offline_offline.message: beifahrer — no agent running. Nothing can reach this browser.

toolbar_offline_unauthorized.message: beifahrer — the bridge refused the pairing token. No agent can reach this browser.

toolbar_offline_protocol.message: beifahrer — bridge and extension versions do not match. No agent can reach this browser.

pairing_description.message: Run `beifahrer token` on this computer and paste what it prints. The token proves to the bridge that it is talking to this extension and not to a web page.

ports_description.message: Every agent session listens on its own port of this range, and beifahrer connects to each one it finds. The sessions must use the same range (BEIFAHRER_PORT, BEIFAHRER_PORT_COUNT) and the same token.

pairing_saved_offline.message: Saved. No agent session is running yet — each starts with your agent, and the extension connects then.

pause_group_description.message: Also from the toolbar popup, the Stop button on a page the agent is working on, or Alt+Shift+B. Only you can resume: the agent cannot.

screenshots_description.message: Chromium only takes a screenshot with access to all sites. beifahrer still takes one only on sites you set to Read or higher.

tabs_confirm_close.message: Ask me before the agent closes tabs

tabs_autosave.message: Keep automatic snapshots of my windows

tabs_autosave_detail.message: The last 20, in this browser only

session_nothing_open.message: No web page is open — nothing to save.

session_name_empty.message: Give the session a name first.

session_name_whitespace.message: The name must not start or end with a space.

session_name_too_long.message: The name is longer than $MAX$ characters.

session_name_control.message: The name must not contain control characters.

session_name_reserved.message: Names starting with “$PREFIX$” are the automatic snapshots — pick another.

autos_empty.message: None yet — one is taken a few seconds after your tabs change.

closed_empty.message: The browser remembers no closed window right now.

sites_empty.message: No site allowed yet. Open a site and use the toolbar button.

confirm_heading_change.message: Your agent wants to change a page

confirm_heading_close.message: Your agent wants to close tabs

confirm_remember_site.message: Don’t ask again on this site

confirm_remember_close.message: Don’t ask again before closing tabs

confirm_timeout.message: No answer in two minutes counts as no.

confirm_gone.message: This request is no longer waiting

confirm_gone_description.message: It was answered already, or the agent stopped waiting. You can close this window.

pill_stop_tooltip.message: Pause beifahrer: the agent gets nothing from this browser until you resume it in the toolbar
